label: Machine over SSH
description: A server, a NAS, a Raspberry Pi: commands and files, approved like those of this machine
agentGuide: A machine reached over SSH. Use the tools ssh_run (a shell command), ssh_read_file and ssh_write_file with this service_id — never call_external_service, never `ssh` or `sshpass` through run_command: the credentials are Allkin's, you never see nor need them. Each call is approved by the user like a command of the machine. The commands run in the account's login shell on that machine, not on Allkin's: read the system first when it matters (`uname -a; cat /etc/os-release`). Nothing interactive (no editor, no pager, no password prompt): use `sudo -n` and say so if it asks for a password.
